title: Criteria/matrix mismatch
text: Criteria/matrix mismatch: the pass-outcome row has no outcome for a pass that completes review execution but is superseded before publication. Existing behavior publishes neither review nor check run, while the matrix's generic Completion outcome requires check-run output. Add this branch and specify its actual record surfaces consistently with AC1/AC2.
rationale: Real defect: the flagged lines changed in 3c5c359, the next commit. Ronda v0.2.0 posted no matching finding on this head. Spec PR counted in scope: Ronda reviews spec PRs and reports no findings. Verdict drafted by the assistant and accepted by LH without per-record review (delegated 2026-09-30).
